title: CodeWalk: Generating Coding Benchmarks by Walking a Problem Graph
abstract: arXiv:2610.15345v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-quality coding problems are expensive to collect. Benchmarks such as SWE-bench rely on substantial human curation, while synthetic alternatives typically rely on costly model generation and validation. In this work, we show that new coding problems can be created at almost no cost by composing existing ones. We formulate problem generation as code composition: verified atomic problems are combined into level-$N$ tasks, and a task is kept only if every atomic problem remains unsolved and a joint reference solution passes the same check used at evaluation time. The entire task-construction process is programmatic and requires no language-model generation or validation. We instantiate this approach in four coding settings: multi-bug repair, proof completion, complexity analysis, and clone equivalence. translated_title: CodeWalk：通过遍历问题图生成编程基准
translated_abstract: 高质量的编程问题收集成本高昂。诸如SWE-bench之类的基准测试依赖大量人工整理，而合成的替代方案通常依赖昂贵的大模型生成与验证。在这项工作中，我们展示了通过组合现有的问题，几乎可以零成本地创建新的编程问题。我们将问题生成形式化为代码组合：将经过验证的原子问题组合成N级任务，只有当每个原子问题仍未被解决、且一个联合参考解决方案能通过评估时所用的相同检查时，该任务才会被保留。整个任务构建过程是程序化的，无需语言模型生成或验证。我们在四种编程场景中实例化了该方法：多缺陷修复、证明补全、复杂度分析和克隆等价性。生成的任务对前沿模型具有挑战性，随着组合深度的增加，所有模型的表现都会下降。
tldr: 该论文提出CodeWalk方法，通过程序化地组合已验证的原子编程问题，在不依赖语言模型生成或验证的情况下近乎零成本地构建新的编程基准任务，且这些任务随组合深度增加对前沿模型极具挑战性。
en_tdlr: CodeWalk creates new coding benchmarks at almost no cost by programmatically composing verified atomic problems into compositional tasks without language-model generation or validation, and the resulting tasks challenge frontier models as compositional depth increases.
